title: Multichannel Delivery in Healthcare: The Impact of Telemedicine Centers in Southern India
near_miss_reason: Time-varying controls and inverse-propensity weights in every column: all visit-rate regressions include i.camp_level and i.lag_camp_level (vision camps within 10 km this and last month) and time-varying distance categories to Dindigul, other secondary hospitals and non-Madurai telemedicine centers (i.dgl_dist_ctrl_var i.scnd_hosp_ctrl_var i.other_vc_ctrl_var), and weight by [pweight=obs_weight] = IPW from a village-level propensity model on common support (5b: IPW not eligible). Later tables split treatment by distance band x Madurai distance (multiple treatments). Shipped data are synthetic.
eligible_reason: Staggered binary design: vc_treatment_10km = 1 once a Madurai-supported vision/telemedicine center opens within 10 km of the village (19 distinct opening dates among 709 treatment-group villages in the synthetic file), village FE (absorb vlg_id) and month FE (i.pd), two-way clustered by village and month. No reported column is free of the time-varying controls and IPW weights.
design_notes: FullCode_e-supplement.do: Table 1 propensity score model (logit; support1pct; obs_weight = IPW, line 307). Table 2 (lines 437-446): ntwrk_vst_rt, vc_vst_rt, madurai_vst_rt, madurai_nonreferral_vst_rt on i.pd vc_treatment_10km + controls, absorb(vlg_id) [pweight=obs_weight], cluster(vlg_id pd). Table 3: new vs return patients. Later tables: general, cataract, specialty, revenue, distance outcomes; distance-band x Madurai-distance treatments (line 617). SyntheticDatasetCode_e-supplement.do reproduces the first stage and a blurred network visit rate (blurred_ntwrk_vst_rt).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Synthetic file: 2,032 villages x 113 months; 709 treatment-group villages with 19 distinct closest-VC opening dates (largest 16/04/2007: 132 villages, 04/09/2014: 72).

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (camp levels, distance categories) and IPW pweights; synthetic data
specs.treatment_definition: Madurai-supported telemedicine center within 10 km open
